original_query: Do most buyers type the URL address directly into Internet or use a search engine every visit?

confirmed.answer_text: 55% of buyers typed the web address directly into the Internet.; Only 21% used a search engine every time before visiting the site.
confirmed.summary: This infographic from the CABLETELEVISION ADVERTISING BUREAU presents survey results from a 2013 automotive buyers study, showing how buyers first learn the URL address of an auto manufacturer's website. The data indicates that 55% typed the URL directly into the Internet, while 42% searched on the Internet, and only 21% used a search engine every time before visiting. Other sources include advertisements (27%) and word of mouth (18%).
key_facts: 55% of buyers typed the web address directly into the Internet.
Only 21% used a search engine every time before visiting the site.
